# prepfrancais

> AI-powered preparation for the TEF and TCF Canada French exams. Learners
> write or speak in French, receive CEFR grading (A1–C2) with every error
> highlighted, explained and categorised, then drill their own mistakes through
> spaced repetition.

Site: https://prepfrancais.com
Languages: French and English interface; all exam material stays in French.

## What the platform enforces

The official TCF Canada limits are applied end to end — the interface shows
them while the candidate works, and the grader applies matching score caps.

Expression écrite — 60 minutes for all three tâches:
- Tâche 1, message court: 60–120 words, ~15 min
- Tâche 2, article/blog/lettre: 120–150 words, ~20 min
- Tâche 3, texte argumentatif: 120–180 words, ~25 min

Expression orale — recording stops automatically at the limit:
- Tâche 1, entretien dirigé: no preparation, 2 min
- Tâche 2, exercice en interaction: 2 min preparation, 3 min 30 speaking
- Tâche 3, expression d'un point de vue: 2 min preparation, 2 min 30 speaking

Score caps applied in code, not merely requested of the model:
- 5+ real errors caps the result at B1; 2–4 real errors caps it at B2
- Below the word minimum caps at B1; below half the minimum caps at A2
- Above 1.5× the maximum caps at B2
- A spoken answer that does not address the consigne caps at B1

Every cap applied is returned to the learner with its reason, so a lowered
level is always explained.

## Error categories used in grading

prépositions · orthographe · conjugaison · accord en genre et nombre ·
anglicismes · améliorations C1 (style upgrades, which never count as errors)

## Key pages

- /: what the platform does
- /tef-tcf-writing-guide: long-form guide to the written exam
- /blog: articles on exam technique and French grammar
- /recent-topics: real recent consignes with model answers
- /practice: writing practice against official tâches
- /speaking: speaking practice with the official timers
- /reading, /listening: comprehension papers
- /pricing: plans. Payment processing is not live yet and the page says so.

## Usage

Content may be quoted with attribution to prepfrancais and a link to the source
page. The exam constraints above are drawn from the official TCF Canada format;
verify current rules with France Éducation international before relying on them.
